REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-54824  Utilities Operations Planning: Aligning Financial Models, Resource Management, and
  Infrastructure Goals

  Welcome remarks were made by President Maguire.

  Anatole Falagan, General Manager, Utilities Department, provided background
  information on the process involved in the production of the presentation.

  Tony Foster, Director of Business Services, Utilities Department, welcomed
  everyone, shared logistics, highlighted the retreat’s interactive focus, and outlined
  the agenda.

  Anatole Falagan, General Manager, Utilities Department, encouraged active
  participation and stressed the focus on long-term programs in today’s discussions.

  Daniel Gutierrez, Manager of Budget and Rates, Utilities Department, and Stefanie
  Clavery, Acting Senior Director of Finance, Utilities Department, presented the
  Financial Models.
